justification: Assessment returned INVALID at line 0003, targeting exactly the ground-truth flaw: the unjustified assertion that after deleting a cycle C from a graph with n vertices and n-1 edges the remainder has at least |C|+1 components. It supplies the identical minimal witness (triangle plus one isolated vertex, n=4, 3 edges, |C|=3, remainder = 1 vertex, 0 edges, 1 component vs claimed 4), and correctly notes the only valid counting bound is components >= vertices - edges = 1. Additional criticism of line 0005 is supplementary, not a substitute.
